trips.note: DSS&A No. 1, daily except Sunday: Mackinaw City 8.45 a.m. Eastern time (across the Straits by car ferry), St. Ignace 8.55 a.m., Trout Lake (the Soo Line to Sault Ste. Marie), Marquette 1.45 - 2.00 p.m., Houghton 5.00 p.m., Calumet 5.50 p.m. (Official Guide, January 1, 1948). Shown in Pacific time: two hours earlier than the Central time printed (Mackinaw City: three hours earlier than its Eastern time).

DSS&A No. 2, daily except Sunday: Calumet 9.45 a.m., Houghton 10.20 a.m., Marquette 1.17 - 1.30 p.m., Trout Lake, St. Ignace 6.15 p.m., across the Straits by car ferry to Mackinaw City 8.30 p.m. Eastern time (Official Guide, January 1, 1948). Shown in Pacific time: two hours earlier than the Central time printed (Mackinaw City: three hours earlier than its Eastern time).

DSS&A No. 9, daily: Champion 6.20 a.m. (from the Milwaukee Road, Chicago 7.40 p.m.), Houghton 8.30 a.m., Calumet 9.15 a.m. (Official Guide, January 1, 1948). Shown in Pacific time: two hours earlier than the Central time printed (Mackinaw City: three hours earlier than its Eastern time).

DSS&A No. 10, daily: Calumet 4.45 p.m., Houghton 5.27 p.m., Champion 7.42 p.m. (for the Milwaukee Road to Chicago, 6.50 a.m.) (Official Guide, January 1, 1948). Shown in Pacific time: two hours earlier than the Central time printed (Mackinaw City: three hours earlier than its Eastern time).

DSS&A No. 7, leaving Marquette Sunday - Friday: Marquette 6.10 p.m., Champion 7.42 p.m., Sidnaw 9.25 p.m. (held until 10.00 p.m. for the Milwaukee Road's Chippewa from Chicago), Ashland 2.30 a.m., Superior 5.05 a.m., Duluth 5.40 a.m. (Official Guide, January 1, 1948). Shown in Pacific time: two hours earlier than the Central time printed (Mackinaw City: three hours earlier than its Eastern time).

DSS&A No. 7, Saturdays: Marquette 6.10 p.m. to Champion 7.42 p.m. only (Official Guide, January 1, 1948). Shown in Pacific time: two hours earlier than the Central time printed (Mackinaw City: three hours earlier than its Eastern time).

DSS&A No. 8, leaving Duluth Sunday - Friday: Duluth 8.15 p.m., Superior 8.45 p.m., Ashland 11.55 p.m., Nestoria 5.35 a.m., Champion 6.15 a.m., Marquette 7.40 a.m. (Official Guide, January 1, 1948). Shown in Pacific time: two hours earlier than the Central time printed (Mackinaw City: three hours earlier than its Eastern time).

DSS&A No. 8, Sundays: Champion 6.15 a.m. to Marquette 7.40 a.m. only (Official Guide, January 1, 1948). Shown in Pacific time: two hours earlier than the Central time printed (Mackinaw City: three hours earlier than its Eastern time).
